faq.question: How do I get results online?
faq.answer: Before your test, your personal details are recorded at reception. As soon as your results are ready, you'll receive an SMS notification on your mobile phone. Results are also sent to the email address you provided or to your doctor's email.

faq.question: If a test can be done using several methods, which one should I choose?
faq.answer: Detailed information about each test is available in the description section of our website. The advantages and limitations of each method are listed separately. Based on this information, you can choose the method best suited to your diagnostic needs. If you find it hard to decide, your doctor or our laboratory specialists can guide you.

faq.question: How do I book a doctor's appointment?
faq.answer: This service will be available soon. Please keep following us or contact us through the contact section for more information.

faq.question: I want to take the XXX test. Do I need to come on an empty stomach? How much does it cost?
faq.answer: You can find the test you need through the site's "search" section or its relevant category. The price of the test is listed on its page. The "Test Preparation" section provides detailed information on whether the test requires fasting or any other conditions.

faq.question: How do I register online?
faq.answer: To register online, go to memorialhospital.az and start the process in the "Registration" section. By entering your personal details, you can register both yourself and your family members. Then, in the "Laboratory Tests" section, choose the tests you need and add them to your cart. You can pay online by card or in person at the clinic.

faq.question: Can I have my tests taken at home without coming to the clinic?
faq.answer: Yes, we offer a home sample collection service. Simply call our call center and give the operator your address and other necessary details. Our medical team will be sent to your home or office as soon as possible to collect the samples professionally.

faq.question: We would like to have our company's employees undergo regular check-ups. Are there any discounts? Can the examinations and tests be carried out on-site without visiting the clinic?
faq.answer: Yes, we offer special discounted check-up packages for corporate clients. When needed, our medical team can also travel to your employees' location — your office or other workplace — to carry out the relevant examinations and tests on-site. Please contact us directly for more information and cooperation.

privacy: Memorial Hospital's privacy policy and data protection.
At Memorial Hospital, we consider the protection of your personal data a priority. This Privacy Policy explains how your personal data is collected, used and protected when you use our services.
We may collect the following information:
First name, last name, date of birth
Information you enter during online appointment booking
The collected data is used for the following purposes:
Your personal data is stored on encrypted servers and the necessary security measures are applied. Your data is accessible only to authorized personnel.
Important note about the current version of this website
In this version of the website, registration and appointment data
is not sent to a server

— it is stored only in your browser's memory (localStorage). This means the data remains on that device and may be visible to other people who have access to it. If you are using a shared or public computer, log out and clear your browser data once you have finished.
Passwords are not stored in plain text but in hashed form using the PBKDF2 algorithm. Nevertheless, we recommend not entering particularly sensitive health information in this form.
The website does not use third-party cookies for advertising or analytics purposes. Only the following technical storage elements are used:
— active session (your name, contact details, appointments)
You may delete this data at any time through your browser settings.
Your personal data is shared with third parties only in the following cases:
Medical necessity (consultation with other medical institutions)
For questions regarding our privacy policy, you may contact us:
42 U. Hajibeyli St., Narimanov district, Baku
